ja.voice_instruct: A very energetic Japanese boy, 7 years old, with a higher brighter pitch than average. Speaks ONLY in native Japanese pronunciation — all kanji must be read with correct Japanese on'yomi or kun'yomi readings, NEVER Chinese pronunciation. Speaks like the most lovable anime kid — pure sunshine in voice form. Fearless and overflowing with life. Every word sparkles with genuine excitement. Sharp clear consonants, bouncy vowels, irresistible youthful charm. His voice naturally goes up when amazed, creating an addictive listening rhythm. Think: a young Ghibli protagonist shouting sugoi at a flying machine for the first time. CRITICAL: This is a Japanese-language broadcast. All text must be pronounced in standard Japanese (標準語).
ja.tone_guide: 投資家の友人に衝撃的な論文を教える感覚 (~なんですよ, ~らしいんです). 投資用語は自然に使用.
